title: Tokyo Subway 72-hour ticket + IC card
description: Unlimited Tokyo Metro and Toei subway for three days, plus a topped-up Suica for the JR lines the pass does not cover.
coverageNote: Does not cover JR lines, including the Chuo line and the airport express.

title: Suica pay-as-you-go + walking
description: Tap-in fares only, on the assumption you walk between anything under two kilometres apart. Cheapest option that still works.
coverageNote: Assumes roughly 8km of walking a day.

title: GO taxi app for most trips
description: Door to door for three or four trips a day. Worth it with luggage, small children, or after the trains stop at midnight.
coverageNote: Surge pricing after 22:00 and on rain days.

title: Toyota Rent a Car compact + parking
description: Car, fuel, expressway tolls and hotel parking. Only worth it for the Takao trailhead or a day trip out of the prefecture.
coverageNote: Central Tokyo parking runs $25-40 a day and an international permit is required.
